title: Rural Country Nights Near Nashville - Private RV
description: Escape to peaceful country nights just 30 mins from downtown Nashville. This private 2 Bdr, 1.5 bath RV retreat features private parking, a cozy patio off the bunk room, a propane fire pit, seasonal pool & a hammock nestled in the trees. Enjoy a dozen farm fresh eggs on arrival, plus the charm of chickens on the property & roosters crowing nearby. You may also see our neighbors goats wandering around. Quiet, unique and close to it all- your relaxing getaway awaits.
